items.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
items.summary: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

items.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
items.summary: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.

items.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
items.summary: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

items.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
items.summary: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

items.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
items.summary: Eligible assets for the new accounts include listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs, with providers handling tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.

items.title: Bitmine makes largest ether purchase since June as Tom Lee points to crypto's strong Q3
items.summary: Company Chairman Lee said crypto’s recent outperformance could draw more institutional investors.

items.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin buys, adding $370 million of BTC last week
items.summary: It's the first week of bitcoin purchases for the Michael Saylor-led company in about two months.

items.title: Robinhood Chain beats Ethereum in daily revenue as memecoin trading takes over
items.summary: The two-month-old network processed a record 5.52 million transactions on Aug. 30 as users launched 22,600 tokens and memecoin trading tools drove most of the $2.66 million in revenue.

items.title: Sberbank plans to add ether and USDT as collateral for crypto-backed loans: Report
items.summary: The Bank of Russia recently included ETH and USDT in a draft list of cryptocurrencies approved for public trading on Russian exchanges.

items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Aug. 31, 2026

items.title: U.S. jobs report, Russia’s digital ruble rollout: Crypto Week Ahead
items.summary: Your look at what's coming in the week starting Aug. 31.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades near $78,000; Strategy buys BTC for first time since late June
items.summary: The price of crude oil is surging higher after overnight military strikes in Iran, with Trump once again proclaiming victory.

items.title: Luke Dashjr exits mining pool Ocean after split over Bitcoin mining’s future
items.summary: The split was mutual, with both parties citing differing views on the future of Bitcoin mining and recent protocol developments.

items.title: September Fed rate hike fears look overblown as the probability stands at just 58%, not 90%
items.summary: Odds of a rate hike in September remain below 60% despite Warsh's hawkish speech on Friday. Observers downplay fears of tightening.

items.title: Zcash private transactions could go from three-second waits to under 200 milliseconds
items.summary: Zakura says a new cryptography stack makes mobile proof generation more than 14 times faster, removing one of the biggest delays users face when sending private ZEC.

items.title: Cronos halts blockchain after $75 million lending exploit hits lending app Tectonic
items.summary: An attacker allegedly pushed Tectonic’s thinly traded TONIC token up 100-fold, used it as collateral to borrow real assets and left most funds stranded when Cronos validators paused the network.

items.title: Bitcoin barely blinks as U.S. hits Iran, sending oil higher and stocks lower
items.summary: BTC remains August's best-performing asset after the latest escalation in geopolitical tensions.

items.title: Mystery surrounds why an OG burned $1M in Bitcoin
items.summary: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?

items.title: Japanese regulator requests tax filing exemption for trust-type stablecoins in 2027 reform
items.summary: Japan’s FSA requested to exempt trust-type stablecoins from mandatory tax filings starting in fiscal year 2027, arguing that it would improve their use as transaction tools.

items.title: Metaplanet moves 4,800 BTC worth $377M to Coinbase
items.summary: The Japanese Bitcoin treasury company has transferred 10,270 BTC to Coinbase Prime this week, an amount equal to more than 29% of its reported holdings.
